Claude Certified Architect — Professional (CCAR-P)

Complete study materials for Anthropic's professional-tier Claude certification: seven domain volumes taught from first principles, a 64-question practice bank, and a system design guide. Built from the official exam guide v1.0 (effective July 2026).

Exam codeCCAR-P
Questions63
FormatMC + multi-response
Duration120 min
Pass mark720 / 1000
Fee$175

Domain volumes

1. Solution Design & Architecture

17%

Business problem to Claude solution, end-to-end architectures, workflow vs agentic patterns, multi-agent orchestration, decomposition, business value pillars and SLAs.

2. Claude Models, Prompting & Context

13%

Model selection trade-offs, system prompts, zero/few-shot and chain-of-thought, context management, prompt caching economics, Skills.

3. Integration

19%

Tool and agent configuration, auth gaps, accuracy-latency trade-offs, observability at scale, RAG pipelines, retrieval strategies, MCP vs API vs agent-to-agent, progressive discovery.

4. Evaluation, Testing & Optimization

16%

Eval metrics, datasets and mixed methods, LLM-as-judge, A/B testing, diagnosing failures, token/latency/cost optimization, observability.

5. Governance, Safety & Risk Management

14%

Guardrails, failure modes, human-in-the-loop, GDPR / HIPAA / FedRAMP, Zero Data Retention, bias and fairness, Anthropic's safety posture.

6. Stakeholder Communication & Lifecycle

14%

Structured discovery, communicating trade-offs, SLAs and expectation alignment, architecture documentation, lifecycle management.

7. Developer Productivity & Enablement

7%

Claude Code rollout, permissions and hooks, MCP distribution, AI-assisted workflows, secrets governance, debugging, runbooks.

Practice and reference

Practice question bank

64 Q

64 scenario-style questions weighted like the exam (21 easy / 23 medium / 20 hard), multiple-choice and multiple-response, each with why-correct and why-each-distractor-is-wrong explanations, plus exam-day strategy.

System design guide

8 designs

Eight end-to-end reference designs: production RAG, tool-using agents, multi-agent orchestration, production MCP, caching economics, multi-cloud failover, evals-as-code, and the cost/latency/quality trilemma.

Exam blueprint

research

Verified exam facts, all seven domains with official objectives, how CCAR-P differs from CCAR-F, how they ask, and key study sources.

How to use this guide

  1. Read the exam blueprint first so you know the weights and the question style.
  2. Study the domain volumes in order. Every unit ends with a "How they will ask this" box — read it twice.
  3. Work the question bank one domain at a time, then mixed. Aim to finish 63 items in under 120 minutes.
  4. Use the system design guide to build architectural judgment — that is what CCAR-P actually tests.
  5. Re-check model pricing and feature availability in the official docs before exam day; marked figures in the volumes are illustrative.
